review.title: PHA enrichments: five genus-reference correspondences with preserved phage inference limits
review.independence_basis: A peer independently read the authored source context, retained primary passages, complete current record and batch 130 guard. The parent independently read the exact actual M5 candidate and receipt before guarded application. The unchanged shared engine, checker, builder and exporter have separate reviews and mutation controls. This document is self-review of the bounded technical correction, not independent whole-record scientific approval.
review.summary: Five existing bacterial genus descriptors now carry their native genus-reference correspondences and matching GROUNDED statuses. Thauera retains the non-unanimous 85/92 majority across three alternatives. The viral descriptor, all original notes and source quotations, five community-level nodes without directed edges, reactor conditions and prior history remain unchanged. This partial diagnostic does not newly approve study-MAG identities or phage mechanisms.
review.scope_description: CommunityMech:000468 taxonomy indices 0 through 4: five exact genus correspondence blocks/statuses, two native inline events, actual guarded application, appended history sidecar and eight scoped native checks. The viral descriptor and biological assertions remain outside the changed fields.
review.selection: The second whole record in the prepared 467/468 pair, following the completely verified and independently accepted 467 canary. Reviewed population is exactly one record. This diagnostic does not resave or expand the earlier 467 assessment.
limitations: Partial database-correspondence assessment with scientific_review:false. Completion of this diagnostic and its scoped checks does not establish whole-record scientific approval, reference-snippet coverage, generated-page integration, final corpus QC or campaign completion.

The native genus populations are Azoarcus 11/11, bacterial Paracoccus 486/486, Azomonas 6/6, Thauera 85/92 across three alternatives, and Brevundimonas 221/221 filtered reference genomes. These populations are not study MAGs, cultured stock identities, reactor abundance estimates or identity probabilities. The Thauera fraction 0.924 is not unanimity; the Azomonas reference population is small.

The five genera represent dominant populations across five separate sludge-derived enrichments, not five identified stocks combined into a synthetic mixture or simultaneous dominance in one vessel. No strain field, species identification or study-assembly assignment is introduced. Paracoccus retains the bacterial NCBITaxon:265 identity and disambiguated label rather than the metazoan homonym.

The source reports 963 recovered MAGs and 711 dereplicated MAGs classified with GTDB-Tk 2.1.1. That study pipeline is distinct from the present NCBI-to-GTDB crosswalk, whose release is not established by its path or mtime. No study MAG placement was independently recomputed here. The 4294 pOTUs and predicted viral lifestyles are distinct from bacterial reference populations.

Source examination covered the whole current record and selected retained primary abstract/main-text passages on dominant genera, reactor design and MAG methods. No fresh full-paper assessment, figure-pixel inspection, separate supplemental analysis, raw-read analysis or study-MAG review was performed.

Predicted host links and defense systems remain predictions. Coupled community turnover and SEM coefficients remain associations; kill-the-winner succession is model-inferred. AMG transcription does not establish productive lysis, function or a contribution to PHA yield. All five community-level nodes, absence of directed causal edges and open discussions remain unchanged.

Five independent 2 L sequencing batch enrichments, their distinct carbon sources, 12 h feeding regime, 26 degrees C and 145-day duration remain separate from the 400 mL accumulation assay. Oxygen control from that assay is not transferred to enrichment cultivation.

The non-unanimous Thauera reference context and all historical unavailable-crosswalk notes are preserved literally. Those notes describe earlier curation conditions and are not a present claim that no mapping file exists. No old scientific review, history entry, source quotation or issue disposition is rewritten.

Source reporting and binding ran locally at ab770f2602416a54835b382e881c7535b5b3e576 with disclosed preparation files. Actual M5 staging, application and eight checks ran at frozen 9276e66296f8063522d34e553e91260fbe9f1a5f with native Python 3.13.2. Their initial state includes the already accepted 467 correction; this is not a fresh clean-tree claim.

The crosswalk is pinned by SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd. Ontology observations retain actual local stat-based provenance without an invented full-database hash. Terms reports its native outcome without an assertion denominator. Strict successor admission and composed historical callers remain separate follow-up checks.

Local NCBI observations verify genus ranks and existing labels, including the bacterial Paracoccus identity. Thauera spans three alternatives and is not unanimous.

assessments.topic: Genus descriptors across distinct enrichment populations
assessments.summary: The five selected descriptors retain their source-supported genus context and absent stock fields. The bacterial Paracoccus identity remains disambiguated. Separate reactors and study MAG methods do not become exact-stock or assembly claims through this correspondence.

assessments.topic: Five filtered reference populations with a non-unanimous majority
assessments.summary: The five native genus blocks and statuses reproduce the exact reviewed populations. Thauera remains 85/92 across three alternatives, with fraction 0.924; Azomonas remains a thin 6/6 reference population. Neither population establishes experimental identity or abundance, and the viral descriptor remains outside GTDB bacterial/archaeal correspondence.

assessments.topic: Actual bounded transition preserves scientific qualifications
assessments.summary: The exact independently reviewed candidate, source bytes and application chain are retained with a new native sidecar and eight completed scoped checks. All biological and historical claims remain unchanged. Strict successor admission and composed integration tests will separately protect the old scientific contract; no full scientific approval is inferred.
